Hah! In a bare XC, look at (PLIST 'CLASS-CLASS) for only one of many such 
instances of lossage.  CLASS-CLASS has a pure plist cell for the SPECIAL
property, pointing into the freelist!  So do other mumble-CLASS symbols.
These appear to be the only symbols with pure plist cells pointing to
impure nonatomic sexp.

"Damn, I knew it wasn't my bug"     -- BIL
